sources.entry: Tigerbeetle | The financial transactions database designed for mission critical safety and performance.

summary.one_liner: TigerBeetle is a financial transactions database built for safety and performance, aimed at OLTP-style debit/credit ledger workloads.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes TigerBeetle as a database for financial transactions, designed for mission-critical safety and performance. It runs as a cluster of replicas, and the quickstart shows a single-replica setup on Linux: formatting a data file, starting the server on a port, and opening an interactive REPL. In the REPL you create accounts with id, code, and ledger fields, create transfers between accounts, and look accounts up to see debits and credits (pending and posted). The README links to documentation on its design decisions, a talk about its local storage engine and global consensus protocol, and an engineering methodology document called TIGER_STYLE.md. The README is short and does not list a full feature set beyond these examples.
use_cases: record double-entry financial transfers between accounts
run a ledger for payments or balances
track pending and posted debits and credits
back a payments system needing high transaction throughput
evaluate a purpose-built OLTP database for finance
how_to_run: In the REPL: create_accounts id=1 code=10 ledger=700, id=2 code=10 ledger=700; then create_transfers id=1 debit_account_id=1 credit_account_id=2 amount=10 ledger=700 code=10;
stack: Zig (implied by TIGER_STYLE.md and the tigerbeetle binary; not explicitly stated)
tigerbeetle CLI with format, start, repl, and version commands
notable: Purpose-built double-entry debit/credit ledger with pending and posted balances
Single binary with format, start, and an interactive REPL for trying queries
Consensus-based replica cluster design, described in linked talks
caveats: The quickstart uses --development mode, which is not a production configuration
The README does not describe installation beyond downloading a zip archive, and the download URL is missing from the text
The README is brief and points to external docs for design and architecture details
keywords: run a ledger for my app
